newsitem.title: USA: Duquesne Beaver Valley, Pa., plant trips.
newsitem.headline: Duquesne Beaver Valley, Pa., plant trips.

text.p: Duquesne Light Co's 833 megawatt (MW) Beaver Valley 2 nuclear power plant automatically tripped off line early today, Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said Monday.
The company has not yet reported a reason for the outage, but the plant is being kept in hot standby and could be back in service as early as Tuesday, the commission said in its daily status report.
No further information was immediately available.
The plant is one of two units at the Beaver Valley facility in Shippingport, Pa.
The adjacent unit, Beaver Valley 1, is rated at 810 MW and operating normally, the NRC said.
